message:
With storm season upon us, I’ve found myself rummaging through old board games and puzzles that have been gathering dust. It’s a lovely reminder that sometimes the best way to weather a storm is to gather the family around for some low-tech fun. 

While we prepare for whatever Mother Nature has in store, I’ve come across a useful resource that lays out some practical tips for staying safe. 

So, let’s embrace the winds by turning off our screens and turning up our creativity. What’s your favorite way to hunker down when the skies get a little gray? 🌪️
